_doc: Sunny Sports real-audio manifest. tools/build-audio.mjs turns every entry of "samples" into audio/<bank>/<id>.mp3 and
js/audio-bank*.js. Sources are staged (read-only) outside the repo; set SS_AUDIO_SRC or pass --src to point at them.
Times are seconds in the SOURCE file. Keys: in/out (or segs:[[in,out],..] joined with an equal-power crossfade of
"join" s), af (extra ffmpeg filter), maxDur (cut + longer fade), fadeIn/fadeOut (s), onsetDb (leading-trim threshold
re. peak), norm "peak" (default, to peakDb) or "lufs" (beds, to "lufs"), loop {xfade} (seamless loop), f0 (measured
fundamental hint; the build refines it to root = MIDI float, measured f0At s after the onset over f0Len s), gain (extra
playback trim), kbps / sr (encoder override), who (voices), inst (sampler instrument), note (what it is, for humans).
flatten (s): loops only, divides out the level envelope (RMS smoothed over that many seconds) before
looping, so a bed that drifts or decays does not step at the wrap. Onset trims: onsetDb is the level re. peak where the
leading trim cuts (default -40 dB); hits whose real attack sits behind a quiet lead-in get a higher value.
